_readme: 08_COMPETITOR_ROSTER — danh sach DOI THU DA BIET. Bot doc moi run de tra loi cau hoi 'thang nay CO MOI khong'. Trong mot phien khong co ky uc, 'moi' chi co nghia khi doi chieu voi danh sach nay. Bot duoc THEM entry; KHONG duoc xoa. first_seen = ngay QUAN SAT DAU TIEN, khong phai ngay thanh lap.

query_calibration_14_08.finding: Do dai query quyet dinh chat luong, da test that ngay 14/08.
query_calibration_14_08.two_words_too_broad: 'fishing shirt' -> 3631 ket qua nhung bi tran ngap boi trang trai phim ngan/tieu thuyet; chi 3/30 lien quan.
query_calibration_14_08.four_words_too_narrow: 'inshore redfish fishing shirt' -> 0 ket qua. 'deer hunting apparel buck' -> 0 ket qua.
query_calibration_14_08.sweet_spot: BA TU, ghep PURSUIT + GARMENT (+1 tu loai). 'duck hunting shirt waterfowl' -> 14 ket qua, phan lon lien quan.
query_calibration_14_08.rule: Luon chay 3 tu. Ra 0 ket qua thi BOT 1 tu, dung THEM tu. Ra >1000 ket qua thi THEM 1 tu.

non_hat_lane_scan_14_08.reading: 'personalized hunting shirt' = 14 ads and near-100% POD. 'fishing quarter zip' = 27 ads market-wide and essentially EMPTY of hunting/fishing DTC - the least contested lane found, and it also carries the best margin (63.2%).
